stories.title: Saputo announces $600-million investment in certain dairy segments
stories.summary: MONTREAL — Saputo Inc. says it is investing $600 million to expand and improve its manufacturing network for certain dairy categories. The company says the list includes its cottage cheese, functional beverages and cream cheese segments.

stories.title: Liberals won't commit to bringing back bill to ban elephants, great apes in captivity
stories.summary: OTTAWA — The federal Liberals have not decided if they will reintroduce a bill that would phase out elephant and great ape captivity in Canada, despite pressure from animal rights activists to do so.
